comps.business_mix_note: Cable distribution (~60% of revenue) plus NBCUniversal (cable networks, broadcast, film studio, theme parks). Only NBCUniversal is comparable to RemainCo; the cable distribution business has a different, capex-heavy model.

Pure-play cable networks (AMC, IFC, SundanceTV, BBC America) and international channels. Closest to the FX / National Geographic / international networks in RemainCo, but far smaller and with no film studio.
